js: 'Voice turns the model hears, WP3 (voice-audio-input design §5, §7), live: voice mode on a dev copy (scripts/dev-copy.sh) with its Gemma 4 12B row (gemma4-12b, audio projector) as the chat model and the speech models the copy\'s Settings name (e.g. a CPU speech-to-text row). The thread sets audio input to on. The microphone is a fake one saying TTS clips on cue (scripts/drive/fake-voice.js; the clips from scripts/drive/make-voice-fixtures.py, the copy\'s own TTS, into target/voice-audio-in/fixtures/voice-de.js). Checks: the drawer\'s verdict and the INPUT chip say the model hears you; a spoken question is answered; its user bubble sits before its reply bubble (the row is written once the turn is transcribed, racing the release); the mic badge names the path; the reply\'s timing line says heard as audio, held N ms; its regenerate tooltip says it answers from the transcript; the stored rows hold the transcript and input audio. It starts the copy\'s model containers. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-voice-heard.json --token-file <dir>.token --base http://127.0.0.1:8896 --mute-audio --podman-guard "" (nothing is audible).'

(async()=>{const j={'content-type':'application/json'};const t=await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads',{method:'POST',headers:j,body:JSON.stringify({model_alias:'gemma4-12b',kind:'chat'})})).json();const s=await fetch('/chat/api/threads/'+t.id+'/settings',{method:'POST',headers:j,body:JSON.stringify({temperature:0,system_prompt:'Du bist ein hilfreicher Assistent. Antworte auf Deutsch in einem kurzen Satz.',voice:{language:'de',turn_detection:'server_vad',audio_input:'on'}})});localStorage.setItem('cvHeard',t.id);location.href='/chat?t='+t.id;return [t.id,s.status]})()

label: the voice-mode button is enabled on the 12B thread

expect: fetch('/chat/api/threads/'+localStorage.getItem('cvHeard')).then(r => r.json()).then(v => { const a = v.thread.voice_resolved.audio_input; return a.value === 'on' && a.source === 'thread' && a.path === 'audio' && a.model === 'gemma4-12b'; })
label: the thread's verdict: gemma4-12b hears the turn

js: (() => { const Real = window.WebSocket; window.__recv = []; window.WebSocket = function (url, p) { const ws = p === undefined ? new Real(url) : new Real(url, p); if (String(url).includes('/v1/realtime')) ws.addEventListener('message', (e) => { try { const v = JSON.parse(e.data); if (/delta$/.test(v.type)) return; if (v.type === 'lmgw.chat.frame' && v.event !== 'delta' && v.event !== 'done') return; window.__recv.push({t: performance.now(), type: v.type, event: v.event || '', rid: v.response_id || (v.response && v.response.id) || '', input: v.input || '', why: v.why || ''}); } catch (_) {} }); return ws; }; Object.assign(window.WebSocket, {CONNECTING: 0, OPEN: 1, CLOSING: 2, CLOSED: 3}); window.WebSocket.prototype = Real.prototype; return 'recording the session'; })()

label: the connect warm loaded the thread's models
the INPUT chip says the model hears you
the journal stored the user turn and the reply with its timing
the session said the turn went as audio (lmgw.chat.input)

expect: fetch('/chat/api/threads/'+localStorage.getItem('cvHeard')).then(r => r.json()).then(v => { const [u, a] = v.messages; return u.role === 'user' && /Tiere|Winterschlaf/i.test(u.content) && u.voice.via === 'realtime' && u.voice.input === 'audio' && !u.voice.transcript_error && a.voice.timing.input === 'audio' && typeof a.voice.timing.transcript_wait_ms === 'number' && u.id < a.id; })
label: stored: the user row holds the transcript, input audio, before the reply; the reply's timing says audio and the hold
